ضَلَعٌ The weight, or burden, of debt, that bends the bearer thereof. (IAth, O, K.) And Strength, or power; (As, S, O, Msb, K;) a subst. in this sense, from ضَلُعَ; (Msb;) and the bearing, or endurance of that which is heavy, or burdensome. (As, S, O, K.) ―
-b2- Also inf. n. of ضَلِعَ [q. v.]. (Mgh, Msb, K.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
